Motivated B.Tech Computer Science student with a strong interest in network security, ethical hacking, and vulnerability assessment. Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools and secure coding practices. Seeking a Cyber Security Internship to contribute to real-world security operations.

Python, Bash, SQL

Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, Metasploit, OWASP ZAP

Network Security, Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing, Cryptography

Linux, Kali Linux, Git, GitHub, AWS (basic)

Cyber Security Intern — Synapse Analytics Pvt. Ltd., Pune

June 2024 – July 2024

Performed vulnerability assessments on internal web applications, identifying 12 medium/high-risk issues. Assisted in configuring firewall and IDS rules, reducing false-positive alerts by 20%. Documented security findings and remediation steps in formal reports for the engineering team.

Web Application Penetration Testing Lab Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Python Jan 2024 – Mar 2024 Set up a vulnerable web app lab and performed testing against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Identified and documented SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities with proof-of-concept exploits. Proposed mitigations including input validation and parameterized queries.

Network Intrusion Detection System Python, Scapy, Wireshark Sep 2023 – Nov 2023 Built a rule-based IDS to detect port scans and ARP spoofing in real time. Achieved 90% detection accuracy on simulated attack traffic.

Password Strength & Breach Checker Tool Python, Hashlib, HaveIBeenPwned API Jul 2023 – Aug 2023 Built a CLI tool evaluating password strength and checking for known data breaches. Used secure hashing practices to avoid storing plaintext credentials.

Bachelor of Technology — Cyber Security

2023 – 2027 (Expected)

Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Pune

CGPA: 8.7 / 10.0

Relevant Coursework: Network Security, Cryptography, Ethical Hacking, Digital Forensics, Operating Systems

Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate Coursera Completed: Aug 2023

Ethical Hacking, Score: 84/100 NPTEL (IIT Madras) Completed: Nov 2023

Introduction to Cyber Security IBM / Coursera Completed: May 2023
